description: This file implements the ClientDao interface using Hibernate ORM for database operations related to Client entities. It provides methods to retrieve, save, and remove Client objects in the database.

classes.name: ClientDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ClientDao interface using Hibernate. Provides database access methods for Client entities.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object from the database using its ID.

methods.name: saveClient
methods.description: Persists a Client object to the database.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Deletes a Client object from the database based on its ID.
